summary: Requested a repeat of the fixed heartbeat fsync experiment (cc2661ee13b14149b7ca04c9d5a35509-experiment), whose single run produced receipt f87365ea88ba4a48a610ba8f380419b0. That receipt is what lets the heartbeat account claim the term inversion happens under genuine file-system latency rather than an injected sleep: every current-term update was written and fsynced, and 89 of 200 attempts inverted with a mean write near 2 ms. One execution cannot separate a property of this container's filesystem from an accident of that run's scheduling, and the claim is central to the account's realism argument. Re-running the same retained inputs executes the identical harness, so a second count either confirms the exposure or shows it varies; no code, inputs or measurements change. The submission is a repeat request with rationale only and validates against submission.schema.json.
